entities.summary: Anatoly Anatoliiovych Shariy Ukrainian YouTuber and journalist. Shariy has been described as pro-Russian by Ukrainian and foreign media, former president Petro Poroshenko, and the Security Service of Ukraine, among others. However, Shariy denies having a pro-Russian stance.
